verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents real-time analytics for opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscribes. It also offers reputation-related tooling: blocklist monitoring for sending domains and IPs, and DMARC report analysis to identify potential sending issues. This goes beyond raw counts on reputation signals, but complaint analytics and inbox-placement guidance are not evidenced. Missing for 10: complaint/spam-report analytics, inbox placement testing or guidance, an explicit sender reputation score or recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can see bounce, complaint, and engagement analytics with guidance on inbox placement and sender reputation, not just raw counts

citations.quote: Track open rates, click-throughs, bounces, and unsubscribes with real-time data.
Monitor your sending domains and IP addresses for blocklist hits with MailerSend's Blocklist Monitoring API.
Receive and analyze DMARC reports and identify potential sending issues with MailerSend's DMARC Monitoring API.
